subject: Trading
title: Forex Trading Sessions
description: A 60-second lesson on Forex Trading Sessions.

hook.text: Forex never sleeps because the sun is always rising somewhere. Three overlapping sessions keep it running.

buildup.text: Tokyo opens first, then London, then New York. Each session brings different currencies into focus.

discovery.text: The London-New York overlap is the most active: highest volume, tightest spreads, biggest moves.

twist.text: Sunday evening to Friday close is one continuous market. Gaps only appear over weekends after major events.

climax.text: Session timing matters. Trading the wrong pairs in the wrong session means wider spreads and less action.

punchline.text: Time zones power the world's busiest market.

quiz.question: Which forex session overlap has the highest trading volume?
